acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:c6090572-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. The team owns the operational strategy and execution of our mid-to-late GTM Sales motion for the NAMER Upmarket organization, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. We build and evolve the sales processes, workflows, data, and policies that enable sellers to effectively manage opportunities, navigate complex deals, and convert pipeline into predictable revenue. Our work spans opportunity management, forecasting, complex deal strategy and structuring, contracting workflows, and Rules of Engagement. We work hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate critical deals and day-to-day business challenges, while identifying where broader processes, policies, data, or systems need to evolve. We partner closely across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other GTM teams to improve seller effectiveness, sales efficiency, conversion, and revenue predictability as the business scales. What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta: - Own the strategy and day to day operations for the Upmarket mid-to-late sales funnel, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. Develop a strong point of view on the sales processes, stage management, opportunity management, workflows, and seller behaviors needed to improve conversion, sales efficiency, and predictable revenue growth. - Own and evolve the operational workflows and data that support contracting and complex deal execution, ensuring sellers have clear, scalable paths from opportunity through contract and close. Serve as a go-to strategic and operational partner for creative and complex deal structures, working hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate non-standard scenarios while partnering closely with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Use insights from individual deals to identify recurring friction and drive improvements to the processes, policies, data, and systems that enable the business to close effectively at scale. - Shape deal strategy and the operational processes that support complex sales motions, partnering with sellers, Sales leadership, Deal Desk, Finance, and other teams to navigate complex opportunities while identifying where broader process, policy, or system changes can make it easier and more effective to close business at scale. - Evolve the Rules of Engagement and the cross-functional policies that govern how GTM teams work together throughout the sales cycle, bringing clarity to ownership, handoffs, deal scenarios, and areas of competing priorities. Lead alignment across Sales and other GTM organizations as our sales motions and business needs evolve. - Own and evolve sales forecast cadences, facilitating forecast reviews with Sales leadership to scrutinize pipeline health and deal-specific risks. - Identify and lead strategic improvements to our mid-to-late funnel operating model, using data, field insights, and deep sales process expertise to diagnose where opportunities are getting stuck or where seller effectiveness can improve. Lead complex initiatives from problem definition and recommendation through senior stakeholder alignment, hands-on implementation, and measurement of business impact in partnership with GTM Systems & Analytics and other cross-functional teams. How to be successful in this role: - 12+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, or a related function within B2B SaaS, with significant experience supporting complex Upmarket sales motions. - Mid to late funnel GTM experience and opportunity-to-close processes across Commercial, Mid-Market, and En

With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE: Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability. We are seeking Staff SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust observability solutions, lead incident response, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit. YOU WILL: - Architect and Implement Observability: Design, build, and lead the implementation of comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, implement capacity planning strategies, and reduce latency across global regions. - Debug and Harden Distributed Systems: Dive deep into debugging extremely difficult technical problems across the stack. Use your findings to design and implement long-term fixes that make our systems and products more robust, operable, and easier to diagnose. - Provide Staff-Level Guidance: Review feature and system designs from across the company, acting as a key owner for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational integrity of those designs. - Educate and Mentor: Educate, mentor, and hold accountable the broader engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems, making reliability a core value of the Replit engineering culture. - Build and Integrate: Write high-quality, well-tested code in Python or Go to meet the needs of your customers, whether it's building new internal tools or integrating with third-party vendors. emergencecapitalpartners-emergence-capit.title: Stay on our Radar
emergencecapitalpartners-emergence-capit.description: ABOUT EMERGENCE CAPITAL Emergence Capital is a leading venture capital firm focused exclusively on enterprise technology. We partner with visionary founders building the next generation of business software – from Seed through growth stages. Our portfolio includes category-defining companies like Together AI, Zoom, Bland, and many of today's most innovative startups. We invest in companies transforming how businesses operate through cloud infrastructure, vertical SaaS, and applied AI. Our portfolio companies are tackling complex problems in financial services, healthcare, legal, logistics, and beyond – building products that drive measurable impact for their customers. The roles below represent opportunities across our portfolio. Each company is at a different stage, but all share a commitment to building exceptional products, serving customers deeply, and creating enduring businesses. If you're looking to join a high-growth startup backed by a firm with deep expertise in enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you. Location: Most roles are based in San Francisco or New York, with some flexibility for remote depending on the company and role. DON'T SEE YOUR ROLE POSTED? We're always looking for exceptional people. If you don't see a role that fits but believe you'd thrive at a high-growth AI or early-stage b2b/enterprise software company, we want to hear from you. Our portfolio companies are building products that transform industries – from AI-powered legal research to autonomous insurance operations to next-generation developer tools. We look for people who are builders at heart: those who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about craft. This is not a general application that goes into a black hole. Our talent team actively reviews submissions and matches exceptional candidates with opportunities across the portfolio as they emerge. Many of our best placements have come from people who reached out before a role was posted. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Work on hard problems alongside teams at companies building category-defining products - Ship products that matter to real customers and see the impact of your work directly - Operate with high autonomy in environments where your contributions shape company trajectory - Learn from founders and operators who have built and scaled successful companies - Join companies at inflection points, early enough to have ownership, funded enough to have runway QUALIFICATIONS - You've built something meaningful; a company, a product, a team, or a function - You thrive in ambiguity and move fast without sacrificing quality - You're looking for a role at an early-stage company (Seed to Series B) where you can have outsized impact - You want to be part of building something from the ground up, not optimizing an existing machine - You have a bias toward action and a track record of getting things done NICE TO HAVE - Previous startup experience, especially in a founding or early employee role - Domain expertise in financial services, healthcare, legal, or other enterprise verticals - Technical background (engineering, product, data science) even if not in a technical role - Experience at a high-growth company through a significant scaling phase

We’re a small, fast-moving team backed by Foundry for Good. We’ve recently signed our first enterprise clients and are scaling our sales pipeline. You might be formatting a data deliverable for a client in the morning and researching a new market segment in the afternoon. Flexibility and a willingness to roll up your sleeves are essential. What We’re Looking For - 2+ years in a customer-facing role at a SaaS or technology company — customer support, sales operations, account management, or similar. - Excellent spoken and written English. You’ll draft client emails, prep decks, and communicate with enterprise buyers. Writing quality

jobgether-jobgether:lever:190188a0-dcea-.title: Platform Backend Engineer — Go/Rust & Distributed Systems
jobgether-jobgether:lever:190188a0-dcea-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Platform Backend Engineer — Go/Rust & Distributed Systems based in Canada. This is a high-impact backend engineering role focused on building the core platform services that power workflow execution, identity, event routing, secrets management, and audit infrastructure. You will work hands-on with Go or Rust to develop reliable, secure, and scalable distributed systems used by engineering teams and AI-driven workloads. The role combines event-driven architecture, multi-tenant platforms, cloud security, and production reliability. You will help design systems where correctness, observability, and operational resilience are essential. The environment is fast-paced and engineering-led, with significant ownership over architecture and production outcomes. This is an opportunity to solve complex infrastructure challenges while shaping a platform used at global scale. Build, deploy, and operate backend platform services supporting API access, Kafka-based event routing, workflow execution, machine identity, secrets management, and immutable audit records. Design and implement event-driven workflows that transform webhooks, alerts, and platform events into durable executions using technologies such as Kafka and Temporal. Develop secure, pluggable secrets-management and KMS abstractions supporting multiple cloud providers, customer-level cryptographic isolation, envelope encryption, and bring-your-own-key models. Implement fine-grained capability and authorization controls for customers, workflows, operations, and service-to-service interactions. Own GitOps-based deployment workflows for versioned workflow definitions across isolated customer environments. Develop onboarding automation covering identity provisioning, compliance configuration, and customer-specific key-management setup. Build secure connector services for third-party APIs, incorporating scoped access, managed credentials, request validation, and pre-execution audit logging. Improve platform observability, performance, reliability, failure recovery, and production readiness through structured monitoring and incident-response practices. Contribute to architecture and engineering decisions around distributed systems, security, multi-tenancy, and operational resilience. Requirements: Proven professional experience building and operating production backend services using Go or Rust . Strong experience designing event-driven distributed systems with Kafka or similar technologies , including retries, idempotency, replay, and at-least-once delivery. Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, or fine-grained access controls . Practical experience with encryption and key-management solutions, including cloud KMS platforms, envelope encryption, or key-hierarchy architectures. Experience operating multi-tenant production systems , with hands-on knowledge of structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and incident response. Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow orchestration platform is a strong advantage. Familiarity with identity platforms such as Zitadel, Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or equivalent technologies. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar, append-only, or audit-oriented data store is beneficial. Knowledge of GitOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as MSP, PSA, RMM, security, or Microsoft 365 APIs. Understanding of security and compliance requirements in environments subject to frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, or CMMC is advantageous. Experience developing multi-cloud services across AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus. Strong problem-solving, ownership, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a high-growth engineering environment. Benefits: Compe

Our partner is looking for a Senior Program Officer based in the United States. This role provides an opportunity to support high-impact public opinion research and intelligence analysis focused on the Indo-Pacific region. You will lead multiple country studies, designing and overseeing quantitative and qualitative research that generates actionable insights for senior U.S. government decision-makers. The position combines research leadership, statistical analysis, regional monitoring, and strategic communication in a mission-driven environment. You will develop innovative survey methodologies, supervise research activities, and ensure projects meet rigorous quality and methodological standards. Your analysis will help integrate public sentiment into broader intelligence assessments and foreign policy considerations. You will also brief senior stakeholders across government and collaborate with diplomatic, defense, and intelligence communities. The role is well suited to an analytical professional who can operate independently, communicate complex findings clearly, and contribute expertise to sensitive, high-priority initiatives. Serve as project leader for approximately three to five country-focused research studies across the Indo-Pacific region. Design and oversee nationwide public opinion surveys, including developing research objectives, methodologies, sampling approaches, and project plans. Develop innovative methodologies for conducting public opinion research in diverse Indo-Pacific markets and identify opportunities to improve research quality and effectiveness. Lead project planning and execution for key countries and coordinate research activities across multiple workstreams. Brief research findings and key insights to stakeholders, including personnel at U.S. embassies, national security organizations, and defense leadership. Integrate public opinion findings into broader intelligence assessments and strategic analyses. Monitor political, social, economic, and regional developments across the Indo-Pacific to provide informed context for research findings. Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise on countries and issues of particular interest to policymakers. Produce a range of written research and intelligence products tailored to different government audiences. Identify and conduct cross-national analyses of emerging and cross-cutting issues within the Indo-Pacific and, where appropriate, connect regional findings with developments in other parts of the world. Provide data analysis guidance and research support to defense stakeholders as needed. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, research partners, and government stakeholders throughout the research lifecycle. Requirements Undergraduate or graduate degree in a social science discipline or a closely related field. Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret / SCI security clearance and applicable Department of State credentials. Experience designing, conducting, or analyzing public opinion research, survey research, social science studies, or related analytical programs is highly relevant. Knowledge of statistical and research software packages such as SPSS, R, and Stata . Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Access . This role serves as a clinical leader and resource for radiation therapists, nursing, and support staff to ensure safe, accurate, and efficient treatment delivery in compliance with physician directives, regulatory standards, and organizational policies. The Lead Radiation Therapist supports workflow optimization, staff scheduling, quality assurance initiatives, patient satisfaction, and collaboration among multidisciplinary teams. This position promotes a positive work environment focused on excellence in patient care, teamwork, safety, and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Deliver radiation therapy treatments accurately and safely according to physician prescriptions and treatment plans. Operate and maintain radiation therapy equipment, including Ethos adaptive therapy, Bravos HDR, Siemens CT simulation Manage theranostics program Perform daily machine warm-up, quality assurance checks, and safety procedures as required. Verify patient setup, immobilization, and treatment parameters prior to treatment delivery. Monitor patients during treatment and respond appropriately to patient needs or emergencies. Maintain accurate documentation within the electronic medical record and record & verify systems. Leadership Responsibilities Coordinate daily therapist workflow and treatment schedules to ensure efficient patient throughput. Serve as the primary clinical resource and mentor for radiation therapists and support staff. Assist with orientation, onboarding, training, and competency validation of new staff members. Promote adherence to departmental policies, safety standards, and best practices. Assist leadership with staffing schedules, PTO coordination, and coverage planning. Support performance improvement initiatives and participate in departmental meetings. Assist in identifying workflow challenges and implementing operational improvements. Facilitate communication between physicians, nursing, dosimetry, physics, and front office staff. Quality and Compliance Ensure compliance with state, federal, ARRT, and radiation safety regulations. Participate in chart checks, incident reporting, and quality assurance programs. Maintain patient confidentiality and HIPAA compliance at all times. Assist with accreditation readiness and regulatory inspections. Qualifications Graduate of an accredited Radiation Therapy program. Current ARRT certification in Radiation Therapy [RT(T)] required. Current state licensure as required. Current BLS certification required. Experience Minimum of 5 years of radiation therapy experience preferred. Prior leadership, charge therapist, or mentoring experience preferred. Experience with Varian, Aria, Ethos, VisionRT, or similar systems preferred. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong knowledge of radiation therapy principles, treatment delivery, and patient care standards. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to multitask and function effectively in a fast-paced clinical environment. Strong problem-solving and organizational skills. Commitment to patient-centered care and teamwork. Physical Requirements Ability to stand and walk for extended periods. Ability to assist patients with positioning and transfers as needed. Ability to lift and move equipment or supplies within departmental guidelines. Work Environment This position works in a clinical radiation therapy environment with exposure to radiation-producing equipment. Appropriate radiation safety training and monitoring are required.
